messages:
Rae (Marketing): Draft is in the doc: https://docs.google/draft. Need quick passes on hero line, benchmark note, CTAs, and HubSpot routing. Can we lock by 3pm PT?

Jun (Product): Read it. Hedge the benchmark numbers (use 'up to') and add a short engineering quote placeholder.

Marta (Design): Hero comps ready. Will export 2 crops and a mobile thumb once copy locked. Need alt text.

Kei (Growth): Adding UTMs now. Header CTA -> webinar RSVP. UTM sample: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=summer2026_launch. Also suggest RSVP text: 'Save my seat'.

Omar (Sales Ops): Routing plan: enterprise -> AE queue, midmarket -> SDR. Which exact tag values? propose `lead_tier=enterprise|midmarket|smb`, `source=blog`.

LegalBot: Scan: flagged 'industry-best' and 'unlimited scale'. Please remove or support. Also note cookie consent on webinar form for EU.

Rae (Marketing): Replaced claims with 'production-grade' and added privacy checkbox note. Placed Jun's quote into hero variants.

Kei (Growth): UTMs and GA event (`blog_cta_click`) added. Will A/B hero lines Speed vs Cost for 24h.

Omar (Sales Ops): Confirmed tag strings and pushed routing rules to staging. Monitoring first-hour leads.

Marta (Design): Uploaded hero_A.jpg and hero_B.jpg to assets. Added alt text suggestions inline.

SchedulerBot: Publish window reserved for 2026-07-20 13:00 UTC.

Rae (Marketing): Locking copy at 15:00 PT. Pushing to staging, will report back 24h post-publish on CTR and signups.
